fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole car (2016 Chevrolet Malibu sedan) in the cars by owner section.

message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Malibu and it already looks sharp, with nice gloss on the hood and doors. We do mobile detailing and could come to you for a quick pre-sale wash and wax plus an interior clean so it shows just as well inside. Would you like a quote?
